newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bakun dam construction contract signing delayed.
newsitem.headline: Bakun dam construction contract signing delayed.

text.p: Ekran Bhd said in a statement on Monday that the signing ceremony for the Bakun hydroelectric dam construction contract has been rescheduled to September 30 from Wednesday.
Ekran, the main contractor of the dam, did not state a reason for the postponement. Officials of Ekran and of the consortium involved in the construction could not immediately be reached for comment.

A consortium led by Asea Brown Boveri AG and Brazil's Companhia Brasileira Projectos e Obras (CBPO) won the bid for engineering of the dam, located in the East Malaysia state of Sarawak on Borneo island.

The contract for building the $5.5 billion dam had previously been expected to be signed in August. The controversial project has been bogged down by legal challenges, including the filing of a lawsuit in June that accused Ekran of violating environmental law. The company has denied the charges.
